title: TBD sim: a playable physics sim with estimated parameters
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: TBD (a working name) is a playable physics sim of a hybrid drive-and-fly vehicle at /arena/tbd/. Drive it on four wheels, unfold the ducts to fly with assisted hover, or run the autopilot stair hop. It works with keys, a gamepad, or touch on a phone.
It runs MuJoCo physics in the browser. The parameters are estimates from the parts list and CAD, not measurements.
